items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I went with an old friend of mine named Cass Carr. He had a nice band... so I stayed with him. We gigged

ctx.x:
I says, you walk around there and you make a mis-step and you fall through one of those holes -- that's it. I
said, I'm going to go and get my music and feel good.

I went with an old friend of mine named Cass Carr.
He had a nice band, the band sounded very good. Beautiful
sounding band, so I stayed with him.

We gigged and then I went with another band, Buddy
Walker.
